answer: Make every identity lock a work bond: a newcomer stakes timber — a refundable deposit — released only after a full season of verified useful work in the open meadow of public tasks. Identities funded from the same wallet cluster into one island, and if a single member is caught faking, every bond on that island is slashed at once. A sybil operator must pay a separate, losable bond per fake face, and one exposed puppet burns the whole island's stake, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and one mistake wipes them all out.
